api_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Datadog API key (DD-API-KEY header)

app_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Datadog Application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY header)

site_env.description: Environment variable name for Datadog site override (e.g. datadoghq.eu for EU region). Default site: datadoghq.com

default_tags.description: Default tags applied to all submitted metrics (e.g. ['env:prod', 'service:pyhall'])

env.description: Worker execution environment. Mirrors PYHALL_ENV. prod enforces hard attestation.
